name: @volt/contracts
description: Shared wire contracts (routes, request/response types, wire enums) consumed by VOLT server + client. Raw TypeScript source, zero runtime dependencies, no build step. There is no barrel: consumers import the concept file directly (`@volt/contracts/modules/x/routes` maps to src/modules/x/routes.ts through `exports`; the server maps it with a tsconfig path because it compiles these files into its own dist). The ai-tools.ts files declare AI tool inputs as plain interfaces; the server turns each one into a JSON Schema with typia.llm.parameters<T>(), so the type is the only source of truth. Their `import type { tags } from 'typia'` is erased at compile time and adds no runtime dependency.
